title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do you wanna get dinner tonight? I can’t drink, though
I told Louie I would have dinner with him and his family. And your no fun when you can’t drink.
I know. I’m out of commission until Tampa. Enjoy
Heard Greene is going to see a doctor in Dallas. Which doctor, what test?
Dr. Pearl in Dallas. He is the surgeon that knows Greene the best and they will do an MRI and check the Shoulder in general to see if there is anything or not. Getting checked on Thursday.
